annotations.title: Exit window: out before or after the largest holders

description: Can I still get out if the big holders leave first? For one vault: what can be withdrawn now, what would be left if its largest holder and its five largest holders left first, how many of them it takes to empty the instant exit, who they are where an operator names them (Spark, Grove liquidity layers), and the run across markets: other tracked vaults lending into the same markets and the pro-rata exit if all of them withdrew at once. With position (USD) and address: the share of your position that could leave now, after the largest holder, after the five largest. Without vault: the vaults it takes the fewest holders to empty, tightest first. Queues and locks are said apart. A scenario under stated assumptions, not a forecast. FREE.

address.description: With position: your address, so you are not counted among the holders ahead of you.

limit.description: Without vault: how many vaults (default 20, at most 200).

position.description: With vault: your position in USD.

vault.description: A vault slug or id. Omit for the tightest vaults.
